description: Shadowfen mud/wattle building culture — round mud shells, thatch, woven furniture, bone-and-reed ritual props, poled rafts and the Hist tree. Sourced at Phase 11 item 6b to close the inventory's critical mud-culture gap. Contains NO Imperial or reed/stilt pieces: material-culture.md forbids blending the two Argonian cultures in one settlement, so the kits are separated rather than the placement rules. (wovenfence01 and argonianbonechime02 are excluded: both NIFs ship without renderable geometry.) Only plank_ferry_swamp_01/03 and rowboat_ferry_swamp_01 carry real hull geometry in the Skyrim Ferries pool; swamp_02/04/05/06 are editor markers and are excluded. Second sourcing pass adds the Skyfall Hist tree (a second hero-Hist mesh), Hist flowers, the rock cairns and rune circle that stand in for canon grave-stakes, a real dugout canoe and a poled ferry raft. King of the Murkmire adds eight mud-house shells from its `argonia/mudhuts` set, with their doorway piece, two doors, windows, chimney, stairs and two awnings; its plugin places no door, window or chimney at a repeated offset from a shell, so none is composed.

snapLogic.assemblies: Composites in this kit: `composite:mud/hut-with-entrance` is `hutexterior` + four `doorframe01` rings + the wood door leaf at the offsets BM&V used on all 11 of its huts (templates bmv-blackmarsh:t0089, t0090 and t0091; the hut part at the plugin's scale 1.30, the entrance pieces at 1.0 and their placed offsets). The rule is that the mud hut shell is an unbroken drum: its entrance is separate pieces, and a hut placed without them cannot be entered. The bare `hutexterior` stays in the kit for ruins and abandoned shells.

compose.note: BM&V's mud hut with the entrance it is never shipped with, composed as the plugin places it (16h K10 ruling D): all 11 `hutexterior` references stand at scale 1.30 (templates carry anchorScale 1.3, partScaleInAnchor 0.769), so the hut part is scaled 1.30 and every piece of the entrance stays at its authored scale 1.0 at the PLACED offset (the unit-frame template offset times 1.30), which keeps the door at player size. Every one of the 11 huts carries the same five pieces, each to 0.01 m: four `doorframe01` rings stepping out from the wall at 6.34, 6.67, 6.91 and 7.22 m from the pivot, yawed 153.74 deg (templates bmv-blackmarsh:t0089 and t0090 hold them two by two), and the `ruinswooddoorload01` leaf at 3.19, -5.92, -3.84 m, yawed 245.41 deg (bmv-blackmarsh:t0091), inside the second ring. The door mesh is the vanilla Nordic ruins wood door the BM&V plugin references by path.

King of the Murkmire's small pod house, `smpodext02`, stood the way the plugin places it. The plugin places the pod 7 times, all at scale 1.0. Six of those references turn it over about its x axis (x rotation 164.6 to 198.3 deg, y rotation -14.3 to 12.3 deg), so the mesh stands the other way up from how it was modelled, with its bulge above the ground. The one upright reference stands at z 4.81 m. This part carries the median of all 7 references: pitchDeg 180.0 (x rotation) and rollDeg 8.11 (y rotation), with the yaw left to the layout. No single shell does this: a kit piece stands the way its mesh was modelled; this mesh was modelled upright. The porch, `smpodextdoor`, is a separate piece.

King of the Murkmire's pod house as the plugin builds it: the pod `smpodext02` turned over as in composite:mud/pod-as-placed (pitchDeg 180.0, rollDeg 8.11, the median of its 7 references), its porch `smpodextdoor` and the porch's load door `door01`. The porch stands where the plugin puts it at the one reference whose pod fits the median tilt exactly (fit error 0.000): 3.37 m from the pod's pivot on a bearing of 185 deg, offset [-0.2993, -3.3566, 1.2229] m, turned 3.35 deg. The other four porch references scatter on bearing (62 to 332 deg), so none of them is a template. The door stands on the porch at template kotm:t0034 (5 placements, offset [-0.44, -2.96, 1.22] m, yaw 1.4 deg), carried through the porch's pose to [-0.9115, -6.2858, 2.4429] m, yaw 4.75 deg, 6.35 m from the pod's pivot. The plugin's own load door stands at 6.31 m on any bearing across its 8 placements, so this composite fixes the entrance at the porch's door. No single piece does this: the pod mesh has no opening, and its door is on the porch.
